name: WEEKNUM
description: WEEKNUM returns the week number of a date within the year, where the return_type argument controls which day the week starts on; return_type 21 returns the ISO 8601 week number.
tldr: Returns the week-of-year number for a date.

parameters.name: return_type
parameters.description: Optional. Controls the week-start day: 1 (default) = week starts Sunday; 2 = week starts Monday; 11-17 select a specific start day; 21 = ISO 8601 (week starts Monday, week 1 is the one containing the first Thursday).

basicExample.explanation: 2024-01-01 is a Monday. With return_type 2 (Monday start), the week containing Jan 1 is week 1.

advancedExamples.title: ISO 8601 week for a late-December date spill
advancedExamples.scenario: A date that belongs to the previous ISO year
advancedExamples.explanation: 2021-01-01 is a Friday that falls in the last ISO week of 2020, so it returns 53.

advancedExamples.title: US week starting Sunday
advancedExamples.description: return_type 1 starts the week on Sunday
advancedExamples.explanation: With return_type 1, the week containing Jan 1 is always week 1, so 2021-01-01 returns 1.

howItWorks: WEEKNUM determines which week a date falls in based on the chosen week-start day. Week 1 always contains January 1. The ISO mode (21) defines week 1 as the week with the first Thursday (equivalently the week containing Jan 4), which can place early January dates in week 52 or 53 of the prior year.

howToSteps.name: Enter the date
howToSteps.text: Provide a date serial or a DATE(...) expression.

howToSteps.name: Choose return_type
howToSteps.text: Use 1/2 for US-style, or 21 for ISO 8601 weeks.

limitations: Week 1 always contains Jan 1, so early or late dates can return 52 or 53 under the ISO system.
For strict ISO weeks in Excel 2013 and later, the dedicated ISOWEEKNUM function is an alternative.
return_type must be 1, 2, 11-17, or 21; other values return #NUM!.

commonErrors.cause: An invalid return_type value was supplied.

commonErrors.error: Week number seems off by one
commonErrors.cause: Mixing Sunday-start and Monday-start systems, or expecting ISO behavior.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: WEEKNUM works identically in Google Sheets and supports return_type 1, 2, 11-17, and 21 for ISO weeks.

faq.question: How do I get ISO 8601 week numbers?
Why is Jan 1 sometimes week 53?
faq.answer: Under ISO (21), if Jan 1 falls in the last week of the previous year, it returns 52 or 53.

faq.question: What is the difference between return_type 1 and 2?
faq.answer: 1 starts the week on Sunday, 2 starts it on Monday.
